integrity: The claim is proved by symmetry reduction and exact one-variable optimization. The recent source is used for the normalization J(K_n)=B_2^n and for the documented scope of its sharpness construction; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Determines the John ellipsoid only for the specific Khachiyan circular half-cone family; it does not determine the optimal central-cut constant over all bodies in a fixed dimension. Early 1988/1990 sources were not independently inspected line by line.
title: Exact John ellipsoid of the Khachiyan half-cone
